title: App code never rebinds the composed app's dependency injections
intent: Composition binds the authentication and session seams once. Rebinding the app's dependency-override map in app code (e.g. replacing the principal provider) silently disables authentication or swaps the database session outside every guard. Overrides are a TEST-ONLY seam; application code has no legitimate use.
reference: app.dependency_overrides on the create_app-composed app is the refused surface.

runtime.rationale: The composed app's dependency_overrides mapping stays writable after composition; the existing freeze seam could hand back a refusing mapping (the same fail-closed shape as the route freeze) but does not yet. The rule stays build-time-enforced until that seam ships.
runtime.tracking: AITT-NL/terp-framework docs/internal/STATUS.md — freeze dependency_overrides after composition (extend the existing freeze seam)
